meta.source: NASA POWER daily (MERRA-2 reanalysis), keyless point API

index.name: BW (burn-weather anomaly)
index.climatology: same day of year within +/-15 days, pooled over every year of the record
index.note: mean-zero by construction; the weights state the contribution of each observed term and are not fitted to fire counts

season.name: SEASON (monthly burn-weather favourability)
season.formula: SEASON_m = exp(same weighted sum with each variable standardised across the 12 monthly means) / mean over m
season.normalisation: the twelve values average exactly 1, so it redistributes activity within a year and never changes the annual total
season.replaces: the hand-typed peakMonths/seasonLabel that used to live in src/data/regions.json

meta.missingValuePolicy: POWER -999 becomes null; trailing gaps persist the last valid day
